opener_episode.why: The closest match to Avery's story (selling high-ticket goods online, as ArtLife.com did with blue-chip art from 2015). The Ben Voyer affluent-buyer psychology episode (2025-10-21) is the alternative. Both predate the 90-day window.

angles.headline: Selling six-figure art online before anyone believed you could
angles.pitch: Avery launched ArtLife.com in 2015 as one of the first online-only blue-chip galleries and scaled it to eight figures a year with 'Click & Mortar': social-first marketing plus curated physical pop-ups.

angles.headline: Inside the celebrity buyer's mind
angles.pitch: Stories from advising celebrities, athletes and HNW clients, including placing a $100K+ Hap Tivey work with Kris Jenner at Art Basel Miami Beach 2024 and the outlandish requests that come with fame and money.
angles.builds_on: Ben Voyer episode on affluent-buyer psychology; Ep. 14 on not persuading luxury buyers.

angles.headline: Making an artist a luxury brand
angles.pitch: How Avery turned Alec Monopoly into a global brand with sold-out exhibitions and major brand partnerships, a lesson in creating desire.
angles.builds_on: Ep. 13 (making a country a luxury brand).
